facts.business: Intense Technologies Limited is an AI-first, platform-led services company that provides enterprise customer communications solutions, enabling organizations to simplify complexity, reduce coordination overhead, and scale customer communications with greater control, intelligence, and resilience across channels and touchpoints.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in the provided excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Key Audit Matters: Revenue recognition for fixed-price contracts using percentage-of-completion method; Provision for Trade Receivables including one-time change in estimation basis (additional provision of Rs.13.62 Cr recognized under exceptional items for receivables outstanding >365 days excluding government/PSU receivables)

key_risks: Revenue recognition risk for fixed-price contracts due to estimation of efforts to complete
Credit risk and recoverability of trade receivables, especially those outstanding >365 days
Change in accounting estimate for trade receivable provisioning impacting profitability
Regulatory complexity and heightened expectations around privacy, security, and governance
Technology transformation risks including AI advancement and enterprise adoption challenges
